description: Local Market Check package: compare organic Google results and Maps listings for one keyword and location, with observed competitor domains, optional own-domain presence and 3-5 action tips. One JSON report, one package price. Read /v1/local-market-check-quote before buying; missing or partial results stay explicit. (costs 0.1 USDC on Base via x402)

confirmNewPurchase.description: Set true only to intentionally buy an identical completed request again. Never use for retries or accepted/unclear purchases.

domain.description: Optional own domain for presence checks; not sent to the provider. Also accepted as "target" or "url".

keyword.description: Search term or local category. Provide keyword or category. A one-element list is also accepted; its first entry is used.

name: local_market_check
